speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you; your age and sexual history, combined with dysuria and pain with intercourse, raise concern for a gynecological or urinary issue. Could you tell me if your abdominal pain has radiated to your right shoulder or if you have noticed any vaginal bleeding or abnormal discharge? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy.

text: Since the urinalysis results are unavailable and your symptoms include nausea, vomiting, and dysuria alongside sexual activity, I need to rule out an ovarian emergency. Have you missed your period recently, and is there any possibility you are pregnant?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain and cramping. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Pain with urination, Burning pain during intercourse.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ectopic Pregnancy

The combination of missed period uncertainty, severe abdominal pain, nausea/vomiting, and dysuria in a sexually active 17-year-old raises immediate concern for an ectopic pregnancy until proven otherwise. Please confirm the result of the beta-hCG test and perform a Transvaginal Ultrasound immediately to visualize the uterus and adnexa.
